credits.title: GDL

credits.title: Game Over
credits.overview: After her sister’s mysterious death, Rebeca uncovers an urban legend about a cursed video game that unleashes a deadly entity. As the line between myth and reality dissolves, she must confront the evil before it claims her and her friends.

credits.title: Art Is Dark and Full of Horrors
credits.overview: This corrosive satire of the Mexican art world unfolds during a week of ferocious preening, dealing and partying. Star artist Chema rules the scene – but if he falls, every vulture of the art market is ready to swoop in.

credits.title: A Father's Miracle
credits.overview: After being falsely accused of a terrible crime, Hector, a man with a neurological disability, goes to a secret prison. His goodness conquers the prisoners, who plan to prove their innocence.

credits.title: Public Phone
credits.overview: After a nocturnal earthquake in Oaxaca, phone systems across Mexico collapse, forcing people to  turn to public phones to communicate. Personal tensions and crises emerge amid the disconnection,  revealing deep internal struggles and complex social dynamics in a chaotic context.

credits.title: Rock, Weed and Wheels
credits.overview: In 1971, two young entrepeneurs decide to organize a race car with lots of indie rock bands livening up the event in Avandaro, Mexico. When only 25 thousand tickets are sold but more than 200 thousand people arrive, things start to get out of control.

credits.title: Bad Actor
credits.overview: During the filming of a movie, actress Sandra Navarro denounces actor Daniel Zavala for sexual abuse on the set during the recording of a scene for the movie. Daniel pleads his innocence and the production tries to prevent the situation from leaking off the set and causing a scandal.

credits.title: The Beast
credits.overview: Pipo, Pau and Mau, three youngsters who spend their time shooting video pranks, visit a distant town where a beast is attacking its residents. Upon arrival, the pranksters will discover that the beast is very different than they thought.

credits.title: A Deadly Invitation
credits.overview: Eccentric millionaire Olivia sends her half sister Agatha, and a group of old acquaintances, a mysterious invitation for a weekend on her yacht, where they will discover the true motive behind this invitation: the celebration of… a murder?

credits.title: Black Moon
credits.overview: The story of three brothers arises between dreams, ideals and frustrations in the context of a community rebellion to defend their river from a construction company.

credits.title: Casando a mi Ex
credits.overview: Mariana believes that weddings are a farce, so she dedicates herself to planning them. credits.title: Sweatshop Girl
credits.overview: Inés works as a seamstress in a sweatshop where pregnancy tests are periodically administered. When she becomes pregnant, she is sure that her condition will get her fired. She does everything she can to keep it a secret.

credits.title: A quien cierra los ojos
credits.overview: In the microcosm of a private school, the latent traumas of adults coexist with the teenager’s wild search for identity. credits.title: Bien parecidas
credits.overview: María allows Cecilia to dye her hair while they wait for Agustín's rehabilitation therapy to finish. This simple fact will change the way mother and daughter perceive their relationship and help them cope with the difficult time they are experiencing.

credits.title: Grumpy Christmas
credits.overview: Bitter, grumpy patriarch Don Servando and his family travel to spend Christmas with Doña Alicia, a relative who becomes his "ultimate nemesis". It may be Christmas, but Don Servando is set on proving to everyone that Doña Alicia is a terrible person.

credits.title: Manchester Acatitla
credits.overview: Miranda, the Manchester Acatitla forward, returns home after a victorious match. On her way back, she faces dangers off the court.

credits.title: Funeral
credits.overview: Zacarías reunites with his ex-girlfriend to go to the funeral of a mutual friend.

credits.title: Fire In The Basement
credits.overview: A vibrant celebration of the enduring spirit of the 68 movement in Mexico, despite its tragic ending with the state sponsored massacre of hundreds of innocent people in Tlateloco.

credits.title: B-167-980-098
credits.overview: The bodies of two young men are found in a small town in Northern Mexico, along with a AR15 weapon, which as we will follow back in time will see where it came from, the USA.

credits.title: Olimpia
credits.overview: The film tells the story of Raquel, Rodolfo and Hernán, members of a brigade at the UNAM during the student movement in Mexico in 1968. Through their photographs, films and writings, we will know the history of the day that the army took the university and how their students united, shouted and never forgot.

credits.title: The Voice of a Dream
credits.overview: At a pivotal moment in her singing career, Rocío discovers that her mother is ill and that her final wish is to meet with her again before she dies. credits.title: Hasta que la boda nos separe
credits.overview: Daniel and Maria are about to get married and have a modern wedding on the beach in mind. But their families have other plans for the celebration.

credits.title: American Curious
credits.overview: A mexican chef meets her love interest in an american man.

credits.title: Beach
credits.overview: Beach is a summary of conversations in Super 8 and Super 35mm that narrates, in a experimental way, the 21 year relationship of a couple up to ther separation. credits.overview: Fernando cannot forget Sofía. She left some time ago and still the littlest things remind him of her. When he meets Liz, he starts to manipulate his own memories so that he can move on, but his own mind has created a strange being that will stand in his way.

credits.title: A Day
credits.overview: Lourdes and Humberto have been married for 21 years. Edgar seeks refuge with Venus, his dog. A waterpark, an afternoon to enjoy. A day that should not be ruined.

credits.title: Porcelain
credits.overview: Between fantasy and reality of her childhood, Marian runs into family, death and sexuality, all in a single day.
